collision detect function is processed per Section 6.8. If this connection is to be dropped due to connection collision, sends a NOTIFICATION with a Cease, sets the ConnectRetryTimer to zero, releases all BGP resources, drops the TCP connection (send TCP FIN), increments the ConnectRetryCounter by 1, performs peer oscillation damping if the DampPeerOscillations attribute is set to TRUE. If an OPEN message is received, all fields are checked for correctness. If the BGP message header checking (BGPHeaderErr (Event 21)) or OPEN message checking detects an error (see Section 6.2) (BGPOpenMsgErr (Event 22)), sends a NOTIFICATION message with the appropriate error code, sets the ConnectRetryTimer to zero, releases all BGP resources, drops the TCP connection, increments the ConnectRetryCounter by 1, performs peer oscillation damping if the DampPeerOscillations attribute is set to TRUE. If, during the processing of another OPEN message, the BGP implementation determines, by a means outside the scope of this document, that a connection collision has occurred and this connection is to be closed, sends a NOTIFICATION with a Cease, sets the ConnectRetryTimer to zero, releases all BGP resources, drops the TCP connection, increments the ConnectRetryCounter by 1, performs peer oscillation damping if the DampPeerOscillations attribute is set to TRUE

if the CollisionDetectEstablishedState optional attribute is TRUE, the OPEN message will be checked to see if it collides (Section 6.8) with any other connection. If the BGP implementation determines that this connection needs to be terminated, sends a NOTIFICATION with a Cease, sets the ConnectRetryTimer to zero, deletes all routes associated with this connection, releases all BGP resources, drops the TCP connection, increments the ConnectRetryCounter by 1, performs peer oscillation damping if the DampPeerOscillations is set to TRUE. If the local system receives a NOTIFICATION message (Event 24 or Event 25) or a TcpConnectionFails (Event 18) from the underlying TCP, sets the ConnectRetryTimer to zero, deletes all routes associated with this connection, releases all the BGP resources, drops the TCP connection, increments the ConnectRetryCounter by 1. If the local system receives a KEEPALIVE message (Event 26), restarts its HoldTimer, if the negotiated HoldTime value is non-zero. If the local system receives an UPDATE message (Event 27), processes the message, restarts its HoldTimer, if the negotiated HoldTime value is non-zero. If the local system receives an UPDATE message, and the UPDATE message error handling procedure (see Section 6.3) detects an error (Event 28), sends a NOTIFICATION message with an Update error, sets the ConnectRetryTimer to zero, deletes all routes associated with this connection, releases all BGP resources, drops the TCP connection, increments the ConnectRetryCounter by 1, performs peer oscillation damping if the DampPeerOscillations attribute is set to TRUE. In response to any other event (Events 9, 12-13, 20-22), sends a NOTIFICATION message with the Error Code Finite State Machine Error, deletes all routes associated with this connection, sets the ConnectRetryTimer to zero, releases all BGP resources, drops the TCP connection, increments the ConnectRetryCounter by 1, performs peer oscillation damping if the DampPeerOscillations attribute is set to TRUE
